title: World Bloom — Searching for Sunken Shadows — Episode7 Something That Resonated

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu is now living with Kanade after running away, and all four members of Nightcord at 25:00 are working together again. As they each turn their thoughts to the future, something begins to shift in the Empty SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I don't know much about art...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I can't help you there... But seeing you tells me that what you're going through is a lot harder than I realize.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But this also isn't like you, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The Ena I know wouldn't be questioning whether or not you belong or whatever. She'd keep drawing no matter what.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Am I really that much of a musclehead...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, you're right...
I have to keep drawing if I wanna get better.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You have to keep drawing...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Then, Ena...
Um... Wanna try drawing us?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you guys...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah. Remember how you were able to figure out something when you drew Mafuyu that one time?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, I thought you drawing us might help you in the same way.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Then, I'll try doing a quick sketch of you two.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay, great...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, where should we do this?
Would SEKAI be best if you two are gonna model for me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <In that case, why don't we go over there...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Over where?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, right...
That could be really good practice for Ena...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, where is this place you guys are talking about? I'm still totally in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You'll know once you get here.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We'll be waiting for you in SEKAI...!>
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, what is this place...?
Has it always been here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a new area that appeared the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You said how you always have trouble drawing water that one time, so we thought it might be good practice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I did tell you guys that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then, I'll do my sketch here.
I agree that it'll be good practice since it feels pretty strange and mysterious.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Would you guys mind placing yourselves a little closer to the water for me? Feel free to pose however you like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How ever we like? That doesn't really help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, sit for me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, this place is giving off some strange vibes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, it just appeared out of thin air?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A lot has been going through Mafuyu's mind after what happened with her mom...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This place appearing probably means she's feeling something different now.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Nothing's wrong.
More importantly, stay still!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's your fault for keeping us waiting.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm drawing, I'm drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you guys hear that...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Isn't this one of Kanade's songs...?
It sounds like it's coming from the lake...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
That's been happening every now and again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, so it's really coming from within the lake? But why? How's that possible...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Unless something's down there.
Maybe a music player...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Inside the lake—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ena, it isn't safe for you to walk in.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I could've sworn that I just saw one of my drawings down there just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
One of your drawings...?
I don't see anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was only for a split second. It looked like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm gonna see if I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Grab...it...
se_event_underwater_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nope. I can't seem to grab a hold of anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... I swear I saw it.
Or it was just my imagination.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What was it a drawing of?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... It was my sketch of Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, the one you drew when she went over to stay at your house that one time?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's it.
But there's no reason for it to be floating around inside this lake...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if it's because your sketch has some sort of special place in Mafuyu's heart?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This lake was born out of Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seeing your sketch may've had some sort of effect on her. That might be why you're seeing it floating around now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My sketch had an effect on her...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This SEKAI really is strange.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was so sure that I had to keep getting better because I still didn't have what it takes. I thought I needed to give my future more thought...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if my sketch managed to find a way into Mafuyu's heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If my art had a real effect on her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Then, that means my art has the ability to reach others...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If that's true...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, I need to keep improving little by little...
